658:t_1:4.en:
???
「Between you and me, time and distance mean nothing.」

658:t_1:5.en:
???
「You must have noticed it too. Every time you are wrapped in the glow of the $$ゲッター線$$, you touch our legion.」

658:t_1:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I figured I was just seeing hallucinations from the power of the Shin Shine Spark.」

658:t_1:7.en:
???
「For now, I will give you credit. You have opened one of the doors.」

658:t_1:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You mean how I became one with the $$真ゲッター$$...」

658:t_1:9.en:
???
「With that power, you should be able to fight your way through the battles ahead as well.」

658:t_1:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Looks like we managed to hold down the dimensional rift for now.」

658:t_1:11.en:
???
「It was only for an instant, but your life force... the force that seeks to exist overcame the force that seeks to vanish. That is the result.」

658:t_1:12.en:
???
「And it is not only you. Your comrades will open doors of their own in time.」

658:t_1:15.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Awesome! It's a grand parade of all kinds of Getters!」

658:t_1:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「There's even a $$ゲッター$$ bigger than $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!」

658:t_1:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe Getters from parallel worlds have all gathered here.」

658:t_1:18.en:
$$シン$$
「This is no time to be so carefree! Hey, $$竜馬$$!」

658:t_1:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「In this situation, which one am I supposed to call out to?」

658:t_1:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Who can say... But I suspect either one will do.」

658:t_1:22.en:
$$隼人$$
「That guy is $$流竜馬$$ no matter what world he's in.」

658:t_1:26.en:
???
「Both you and they are chosen ones.」

658:t_1:27.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Wrong. We're the ones who did the choosing...」

658:t_1:28.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We chose to fight... to live.」

658:t_1:30.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Vaguely, I've started to understand what you guys are fighting. But...」

658:t_1:31.en:
???
「You need not say the words that follow. Fight in your own world.」

658:t_1:32.en:
???
「The end of myth is your battlefield.」

658:t_1:34.en:
???
「That is right. All worlds will converge, and that very place will become the beginning of a new era.」

658:t_1:35.en:
???
「Fight, warriors. So that you may link those lives to the future...」

658:t_2:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...So the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ had teamed up with Aide $$三島$$ of the $$フロンティア船団$$...」

658:t_2:5.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Without even telling $$大統領$$ $$ハワード$$, he made contact with the survivors of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and was advancing his own plan.」

658:t_2:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「That plan... you mean becoming president of the $$フロンティア船団$$?」

658:t_2:7.en:
$$クラン$$
「If that were all, it would be almost cute.」

658:t_2:8.en:
$$クラン$$
「With the $$バジュラ$$ he brought under his control by combining $$インプラント$$ technology with fold waves, and a corps of mass-produced $$ストライカー#robot$$s, he...」

658:t_2:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「He tried to become the ruler of this universe.」

658:t_2:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even though the universe might be on the verge of collapse?」

658:t_2:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That is where his narrow vision shows.」

658:t_2:12.en:
$$ルカ$$
「He seems to have intended to defeat the $$宇宙怪獣$$ with the power of the $$バジュラ$$, and if that failed, to transfer to a parallel world.」

658:t_2:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「The great collapse of the universe, which comes once every 120 million years, could affect every world, and he's that carefree. What a guy.」

658:t_2:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「We settled things with $$ミカゲ$$, who tried to use $$ランカ$$-chan as a tool for his own revenge, and then fought the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ on the $$バジュラ$$ home planet.」

658:t_2:15.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「By the way, $$レオン・三島$$ had outlived his usefulness, so in the middle of that fight the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ got rid of him.」

658:t_2:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「The fate of a man with ambitions beyond his station...」

658:t_2:17.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Those executives of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ had taken the form of the consciousnesses of several people packed into a single unit.」

658:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean they cast off the human form...」

658:t_2:19.en:
$$レド$$
「It appears they, too, sought to become beings beyond human.」

658:t_2:20.en:
$$さやか$$
「So... was $$ランカ$$ all right?」

658:t_2:21.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Somehow. In the end $$ミカゲ$$ fused with the $$堕天翅$$ $$頭翅#pilot$$, who came to get him, and left together with that old man $$不動$$.」

658:t_2:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「As ever, that man is hard to figure out too...」

658:t_2:23.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It seems Supreme Commander $$不動$$ is really a $$堕天翅$$... and that he is the Wings of the Sun, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.」

658:t_2:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That $$ミカゲ$$ was the lover of a $$堕天翅$$...!?」

658:t_2:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「So he was the root of it all!」

658:t_2:26.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You could look at it that way, though.」

658:t_2:27.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Well, never mind. The fight against the $$堕天翅$$ is over now, after all.」

658:t_2:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「But thinking of it that way, I can see why he was always dropping such cryptic hints...」

658:t_2:29.en:
$$リディ$$
「Just like $$ゼウス$$, he was keeping to the mission of a higher-dimensional life form... So he was avoiding direct interference.」

658:t_2:30.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「For the battle on the $$バジュラ$$ home planet, the $$マクロス７船団$$ and the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ of each fleet helped us out.」

658:t_2:31.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I hear everyone will also be organized into the Galactic Raid Fleet and join the fight against the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

658:t_2:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The decisive battle is finally here...」

658:t_2:33.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Before that, though, one more matter got settled.」

658:t_2:35.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The one between $$アルト$$ and $$シェリル$$.」

658:t_2:38.en:
$$クラン$$
「No need to worry about $$ランカ$$. It was settled in a way all three of them accepted.」

658:t_2:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「All that's left is to head for the galactic center.」

658:t_2:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「If the $$宇宙怪獣$$ really are $$バアル$$, then taking them down should weaken the force that seeks to vanish, and we ought to be able to stop the great collapse of the universe.」

658:t_2:42.en:
$$リディ$$
「The next battle... It will be the one fight that decides the fate of the universe...」

658:t_2:43.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We have to win. For the sake of every life in this universe, too...」

658:t_2:46.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... it's nothing... I'm just a little tired...」

658:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's unusual. For you to say something like that, $$竜馬$$.」

658:t_2:48.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Well, no wonder. Even those of us riding along with you were stunned by the $$真ゲッター$$'s power back then.」

ハワード.evidence: Frontier fleet president; the sheet only has ジョン・ハワード・ダニガン (John Howard Danigan) and surname ダニガン; 658:t_2:5 uses the given name alone (ハワード大統領).
